Subject: Bella Italia reservation
Dear Ms. Green,
This concerns your table reservation for 4 at Bella Italia Restaurant for December 5 at 7:00 P.M. Since you made your reservation more than two weeks ago, the $10.00 charge at the door for the night’s live musical entertainment is waived.
Thank you,
Anthony Russos

questions.stem: How many people will dine with Ms. Green?
questions.analysis: How many people will dine with Ms. Green? 原文依据：your table reservation for 4 at Bella Italia Restaurant您在贝拉意大利餐厅预订了 4 人桌

questions.stem: What will Ms. Green not be charged for?
questions.analysis: What will Ms. Green not be charged for? 原文依据：the $10.00 charge at the door for the night’s live musical entertainment is waived当晚现场音乐娱乐的 10 美元入场费已免除 (A) 取消预订 → 错误 (B) 改期预订 → 错误 (C) 听现场音乐 → 正确 (D) 邀请额外客人 → 错误
